ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.

17. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS

24. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
